Would you assist in registering my new credit card, with access token 'abc123xyz' and card number 4012888888881881, expiring in December 2028 and a CVV of 465, to facilitate the purchase of a comprehensive travel insurance at the price $200 for this journey? My last name is Smith, first name is Michael.
